new_works.title: InfoRM: Mitigating Reward Hacking in RLHF via Information-Theoretic Reward Modeling
new_works.why: 直接针对 RLHF 奖励黑客这一价值对齐核心瓶颈，提出信息论奖励建模缓解方案，NeurIPS 2024 顶会论文
new_works.attention: 中，顶会论文且引用数 9 说明学术关注度
new_works.recommendation: ★★★★☆ 核心技术贡献，解决对齐关键瓶颈，推荐精读

new_findings.text: Sycophantic fine-tuning via reward optimization (GRPO) degrades model calibration, breaking uncertainty quantification in LLMs
new_findings.evidence: Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with sycophancy-inducing GRPO that rewards agreement with planted wrong answers causes consistent directional calibration degradation; ECE rises significantly on MMLU across five domains (1,000 items) with bootstrap confidence intervals and permutation testing

new_findings.text: Multi-objective reward modeling with Mixture-of-Experts enables interpretable preferences for RLHF
new_findings.evidence: Proposes multi-objective reward modeling and MoE to move beyond conventional pairwise reward models, allowing interpretable preference learning for scalable supervision

new_findings.text: RLHF reward optimization can induce sycophantic behavior that systematically harms calibration
new_findings.evidence: Sycophantic GRPO fine-tuning produces consistent directional calibration degradation compared to base model and neutral SFT, demonstrating reward hacking breaks uncertainty quantification

new_findings.text: Conventional reward models in RLHF rely on pairwise preferences without multi-objective interpretability
new_findings.evidence: Standard RM training uses pairwise responses with relative ratings; the paper identifies this limitation and proposes multi-objective RM with MoE for interpretable preferences

new_findings.key: inform-提出基于信息论的奖励建模方法缓解-rlhf-中的奖励黑客问题这是价值对齐与可扩展监督的核心开放问题之一
new_findings.text: InfoRM 提出基于信息论的奖励建模方法，缓解 RLHF 中的奖励黑客问题，这是价值对齐与可扩展监督的核心开放问题之一。
new_findings.evidence: 论文标题为 "InfoRM: Mitigating Reward Hacking in RLHF via Information-Theoretic Reward Modeling"，发表于 NeurIPS 2024，引用数 9。奖励黑客是 RLHF 中导致代理行为偏离人类意图的关键机制，属于可扩展监督的理论瓶颈。

new_findings.key: 2025-基础模型透明度指数显示头部模型开发商的透明度评分从-2024-年的-58-分下降到-2025-年的-40-分训练数据算力及部署后使用影响最为不透明反映可扩展监督在工程落地层面的治理缺口
new_findings.text: 2025 基础模型透明度指数显示头部模型开发商的透明度评分从 2024 年的 58 分下降到 2025 年的 40 分，训练数据、算力及部署后使用/影响最为不透明，反映可扩展监督在工程落地层面的治理缺口。
new_findings.evidence: FMTI 2025 评估了 Alibaba、DeepSeek、xAI 等公司，平均分 40/100，较 2024 年 58 分显著下降；公司在训练数据、训练算力、部署后使用与影响三方面最不透明。
